domain: quasiregular maps on Carnot groups; branched coverings
limitations: Negative resolution of the existence horn only; does not prove global injectivity of all quasiregular self-maps of the Cartan group; non-proper maps and noncompact branch sets remain open; dimension hypothesis n>=3 essential (fails for n=2).
provenance: Independent SCOPE audit of lane-1371 attempt-1; TARGET route; proof verified deductively with live retrieval (scope_literature_search) and full fetch of Kauranen-Luisto-Tengvall and Aaltonen-Pankka.
record_title: Nonexistence of compactly branched degree>1 quasiregular self-maps of the Cartan group
